description.narrative: The SARC Finance Development (FD) project, as facilitated by the Norwegian Red Cross driven by the SARC’s evolving needs and priorities, alongside strategic inputs from key Movement partners, including the British Red Cross (BRC) and the International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies (IFRC). SARC has identified critical areas requiring intervention, particularly in enhancing governance, financial management, and operational capacity to better align with international standards and address organizational challenges. The project is responding to the specific requests from SARC for strengthened internal controls, improved fraud mitigation mechanisms, and a robust framework for financial and operational transparency. The project will target 4 areas of Financial development: 1. Develop an Antifraud and Corruption Policy: Create policies with preventive measures, investigation protocols, reporting structures, and consequences. Capacity Building: Train staff on fraud risks, detection, and reporting, with role-specific modules. Whistleblower Mechanism: Set up a secure, anonymous reporting channel. 2. Develop a Fixed Assets Management Policy: Focusing on procedures for asset acquisition, tracking, maintenance, and disposal. 3. Comprehensive Needs Assessment for Four SARC Branches. Based on strategic importance and challenges will assess financial management, procurement, and operational capacities. Further, create action plans for improvements. 4. Capacity Building across the organisation: Enhance skills of finance and administrative teams to strengthen controls and reduce fraud risks. Implement a mentorship program for best practices in financial management and compliance.
